summary: Frontend test at 375x667 as employee (test_session_employee). Every requested flow passed and there were no page errors. HOME: the 'Latest from our socials' card (home-social-highlight, 343x107) shows the Instagram icon, 'Instagram · 3h' and the TEST body. Tapping it opens instagram.com/aspiregrowtherapy in a new tab. 'See all' goes to /socials, which lists the TEST post under LATEST POSTS. The My tasks, Upcoming events and Company updates sections still render. CPD ATTACH: Library -> CPD -> + -> cpd-attach-button opens the file chooser; I chose /tmp/cpd.png. The card showed 'Claude is reading the certificate…' with a spinner, and Save was aria-disabled (opacity 0.5). Then it showed 'Certificate attached'. Fields were filled: title 'AAC in Early Intervention Webinar', provider 'Speech Pathology Australia', date 2026-05-12, hours 2.5, Webinar chip selected. Save -> 'CPD logged' toast; the entry shows 'View certificate' (cpd-log-file-cpd_53811b4605ef) and the year total went 0 -> 2.5. View certificate opened /api/cpd/{id}/file?token= in a new tab as image/png. Requests: POST /cpd/extract 200 -> POST /cpd 200 -> POST /cpd/{id}/file 200. MANUAL: logging without a file (hours '1,5' -> 1.5, Reading chip) worked; the total went to 4 and the entry has no file link. Removing an attached file (cpd-remove-file) brings the attach button back and keeps the filled fields. Both entries were deleted through the confirm sheet and the total went back to 0. Backend spot checks: PDF extraction returns the correct JSON, text/plain -> 415, image/heic -> 415, no auth -> 401.

minor.issue: Deletes the cpd_logs doc but not the stored certificate object (storage_path), so the file is orphaned in object storage.

ALLOWED_DOC_TYPES = png/jpeg/webp only, but the picker accepts image/*. iPhone HEIC photos picked via DocumentPicker would get 415 'Use a PDF, JPG or PNG'. The UI does show this error, but the experience is poor.

ui_bugs.issue: State is not reset when the sheet is closed with X without saving. Reopening the sheet still shows the previous title, provider, hours and other fields. reset() is only called after a successful save. Reference: /app/frontend/app/cpd.tsx:205-233, 246

issues: A social post (source instagram/facebook/linkedin) in db.updates appears twice: in 'Latest from our socials' and again in 'Company updates' (home-update-upd_TESTSOCIAL). /api/dashboard 'updates' does not filter out social sources.
'See all' section-header links have a 44x16 hit box. Check that SectionHeader uses hitSlop or minHeight 44.

LOW: CPD AddSheet: call reset() when the sheet is closed (onClose / X / onRequestClose), or mark the retained values as a draft on purpose.
LOW: DELETE /cpd/{id}: also delete the stored certificate object (or soft-delete it).
LOW: Accept HEIC/HEIF (convert server-side with pillow-heif) or limit the picker type to image/jpeg, image/png and application/pdf.

If the sheet is closed while Claude is still reading, the extraction result still populates the hidden sheet state (this ties in with the missing reset).
